newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen range-bound, support at 126.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen range-bound, support at 126.00.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: INJECTION OF 400 BLN YEN
*Key September 10-year JGB futures are seen range-bound and taking a breather from recent rallies on Friday.

*JGBs fell on LIFFE overnight due to comment by Keidanren chairman Shoichiro Toyoda on Thursday that it may be time to raise the official discount rate, but overall impact is likely to be limited as this is seen as a rehashing of prior remarks.
